conditioning: All61 cases retained. Source-valid spectral/finite-range rejection or inaccurate values/derivatives is an unresolved capability gap and fails full qualification; never relabel rejection as correct source physics.
initial_yield: Source-invalid rounded history parent step7 must reject as a restart. Acceptance is a source-membership discrepancy, not excused by a post-observation tolerance.
negative: All22 literal negatives plus seed37 must reject; input bits unchanged, baseline recovery bit-identical in the same process. Malformed state lengths reject before integration.
transaction: Actual implicit tentative state change under one-iteration budget, then integrate rejection with exact full incoming state return and immediate same-instance zero-increment recovery
history: All12 frozen rounded reference-parent restarts retained individually; compare accepted source-valid ones to their frozen reference, require source-invalid step7 rejection. This does not claim a continuously accepted12step path.
legacy: Public nine definitions, compiler, kernels and consumer source files remain unmodified; candidate-only generated catalogue stays private
acceptance: Every frozen required criterion must pass on both backends before numerical qualification. Retain all failures and conditional coverage; do not change this policy to obtain pass.
limits: No model installation, public website change, experimental calibration, scientific admission, deployment or push
